Only two of the three papers report this number. The DPO paper reports no AlpacaEval or Mistral results at all, so it has no number to give.

| Paper | Its own method on Mistral-7B | AlpacaEval 2 | Where |
|---|---|---|---|
| **DPO** (Rafailov et al.) | — | Not reported. The paper never mentions AlpacaEval or Mistral. | — |
| **ORPO** (Hong et al.) | Mistral-ORPO-α (trained on UltraFeedback) | 11.33% (SE 0.97) | [ORPO, p. 5, Table 1](http://pdf.invalid/llm/post-training/preference-learning/ORPO.%20Monolithic%20Preference%20Optimization%20without%20Reference%20Model.pdf?dest=table.1&page=5) |
| | Mistral-ORPO-β (trained on cleaned UltraFeedback) | 12.20% (SE 0.98) | same table |
| **SimPO** (Meng et al.) | SimPO, Mistral-Base | 21.5 LC / 20.8 WR | [SimPO, p. 6, Table 4](http://pdf.invalid/llm/post-training/preference-learning/SimPO.%20Simple%20Preference%20Optimization%20with%20a%20Reference-Free%20Reward.pdf?dest=table.4&page=6) |
| | SimPO, Mistral-Instruct | 32.1 LC / 34.8 WR | same table |

**These numbers can't be compared directly:**
- **Different metrics.** ORPO reports only one AlpacaEval 2.0 win rate, with its standard error (p. 5, Table 1). SimPO reports two: a length-controlled (LC) win rate and a raw win rate (WR) (p. 6, Table 4). ORPO's 12.20% sits next to SimPO's raw WR column, not its LC column.
- **Different setups.** ORPO trains Mistral 7B in a single stage on UltraFeedback (p. 5). SimPO's "Base" setting first fine-tunes on UltraChat and then on preferences. Its "Instruct" setting starts from Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.2 (p. 4).

**Where a DPO number on Mistral comes from:** in this folder, only from SimPO's own reruns of DPO. These scored 15.1 LC / 12.5 WR on Mistral-Base and 26.8 LC / 24.9 WR on Mistral-Instruct (p. 6, Table 4). SimPO also reran ORPO and got 14.7 / 12.2 on Base and 24.5 / 24.9 on Instruct (same table). These are SimPO's runs, not figures DPO or ORPO published.

I read the numbers from the papers' markdown tables, which are converted from arXiv's HTML, and checked them against each paper's note. I didn't open the PDFs.
